sloka: प्रहृष्ट रूपौ इव राम लक्ष्मणौविराधम् उर्व्याम् प्रदरे निपात्य तम् ।ननन्दतुः वीत भयौ महावनेशिलाभिः अन्तर् दधतुः च राक्षसम् ॥३-४-३३॥
transliteration: prahṛṣṭa rūpau iva rāma lakṣmaṇauvirādham urvyām pradare nipātya tam ।nanandatuḥ vīta bhayau mahāvaneśilābhiḥ antar dadhatuḥ ca rākṣasam ॥3-4-33॥

translations.english: Then, having slain the rakshasa and taken Maithili back, the two of them, he whose bow was bright with gold and his brother, roamed at will in the great wood, delighted, like the moon and the sun standing in the sky.
